_readme: How each form from the old Squarespace site is handled now.
'hubspot'    - our own markup, submitted to HubSpot's public forms API.
Needs hubspot.formId; fields/labels live in hubspotNewsletter.
'mailto'     - no backend. Send opens the visitor's mail app with the
'deploybase' - POST to a deploybase form. Needs deploybaseFormId.
null         - not connected; the page shows a visible notice instead.
The keys are the original Squarespace form ids; page blocks reference them.

hubspotNewsletter._comment: Mirrors the HubSpot form definition. Field names are HubSpot property names and must match exactly, or a submission is rejected.
